q1.question: How do I start using the site?
q1.answer: Click "Log in", sign in and return to the home page. After signing in, your profile, top-ups and case opening become available.

q2.question: How do I top up my balance?
q2.answer: Open the "Top up" page and enter an amount — the credits are added at once. This is a demo: top-ups are simulated and no real money is charged. Bonuses and promocodes also add to your balance.

q3.question: What if an item didn't appear in my inventory?
q3.answer: Refresh the page and check your inventory history. If the problem persists, write to the staff in the chat with your login and the time you opened the case.

q4.question: How do I contact support?
q4.answer: Write to the staff in the site chat (after signing in). Include your login, the time of the event and, if possible, a screenshot.

q5.question: Can I use promocodes?
q5.answer: Yes. Enter a code on the "Promocodes" page or in the settings, and the bonus is added at once. Each code works once per account, and every code has a limited number of activations.

q6.question: Are the openings fair?
q6.answer: Yes, the result is decided by a provably fair algorithm. Before opening you see the hash of the server seed, and you can change your client seed at any time. After you rotate the server seed on the "Provably Fair" page, you can verify the openings made with the previous seed.

q7.question: How do I withdraw an item?
q7.answer: Fill in the item withdrawal information in the settings and press "Withdraw" on the item in your inventory. This is a demo: after about a minute the item is marked as received, and nothing is sent on Steam. You can cancel the request until it completes.

q8.question: Can I withdraw money?
q8.answer: No. Your balance is the site's virtual currency: it is not money and cannot be exchanged for money.

q9.question: What bonuses are there?
q9.answer: A daily bonus (50 ₴ once a day), a welcome bonus (100 ₴), one for filling in your item withdrawal information (50 ₴), one for your first opened case (100 ₴) and one for your first withdrawn item (200 ₴). Claim them on the "Bonuses" page.

provablyFair.title: Provably Fair
provablyFair.loginCta: Log in to see your seeds and your opening history
provablyFair.intro: Every open is decided in advance by HMAC-SHA256(server seed, client seed:nonce). The server seed hash is published before the open and cannot be swapped.
provablyFair.rotateConfirm: Rotating reveals the current server seed and starts a new one. Continue?
provablyFair.colorNote: The case contents, odds and prices are frozen at the moment of the open, so verifying from history reproduces both the item and its color even if the case or prices changed later.
provablyFair.legacyNote: This open was made before the site started storing the case contents at open time, so it cannot be reproduced.
provablyFair.currentNote: This open was made before the site started storing the case contents, but the current case still reproduces it, so it can be verified. The color is checked against current prices.
provablyFair.unknownNote: The server cannot tell right now whether the current case reproduces this open. Try verifying it, or reload the page a little later.
provablyFair.seedMatches: The server seed matches the hash published before the open
provablyFair.seedMismatch: The server seed does NOT match the hash published before the open
provablyFair.matchesRecord: The result matches the item that dropped
provablyFair.mismatchRecord: The result does NOT match the item that dropped
provablyFair.revealedServerSeedNote: Previous seed — for verifying past opens (not the active one).
provablyFair.verifyFailed: Verification failed. Fill all fields correctly and make sure the case ID exists.
provablyFair.historyFailed: Could not load the open history
provablyFair.rotated: Server seed rotated, the previous one is revealed

stats.periodHint: Both calendar dates are included, in UTC. Choose up to 365 days. Initially: the last 30 days through the current instant.
stats.empty: No case opens in this period
stats.valueHint: Awarded value uses prices saved with each draw, before the sale rate. Realized edge = 1 − awarded value / credits spent; without spend it is unavailable.
stats.expectedHint: Expected edge uses the current case contents and item prices: 90% default + 10% painted, weighted by item odds, against the current case price including a sale. Missing definitions or prices mean no data.
stats.incompleteValues: Opens without a saved winner price: {{count}}. Awarded value and realized edge are unavailable for incomplete groups.
stats.incompleteSpend: Older opens have no recorded case charge. Their per-case spend and realized edge are unavailable; total spend still comes from the balance log.
